import os
import requests

def normalize_expense(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    api_key = config.get("api_key") or os.environ.get("NINJAS_API_KEY")
    if not api_key:
        raise ValueError("Missing API key: set NINJAS_API_KEY or pass config['api_key']")
    schema = {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
            "merchant_name": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "date": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "amount": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "currency": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "category": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "tax": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "tip": {"type": ["number", "null"]},
            "payment_method": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "expense_id": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
            "notes": {"type": ["string", "null"]},
        },
        "required": ["merchant_name", "date", "amount", "currency", "category", "tax", "tip", "payment_method", "expense_id", "notes"],
        "additionalProperties": True,
    }
    headers = {
        "X-Api-Key": api_key,
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    }
    body = {
        "image": payload if isinstance(payload, str) else payload.get("image") or payload.get("document") or payload,
        "prompt": "Extract structured expense fields and return JSON matching the schema.",
        "schema": schema,
    }
    response = requests.post("https://api.ninjachat.ai/v1/vision/extract", headers=headers, json=body, timeout=config.get("timeout", 60))
    response.raise_for_status()
    result = response.json()
    return result
